name: Apply Window Jamb Finish (Brush)
intent: Brush finish coat on primed window jamb. Same rate pattern as MOD_APPLY_TRIM_FINISH_BRUSH (80 LF/hr, coat 2 multiplier 1.13).
doctrine: Rate-matched to TSK_TRIM_BRUSH_FINISH. Window jambs behave like casings/frames in a finish coat — same species, same prep, same approach.
